issues.description: Type inconsistency for student-count attributes: The UML in problem_statement.md declares numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double, but the reference solution implements both fields (and corresponding constructor/getters/setters) as int. Students following the UML will likely implement doubles, which conflicts with the provided reference design and with methods that compute totals and per-tutor values as ints.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the specification and implementation by choosing one type consistently: either (a) update the UML/problem statement to declare both student counts as int, or (b) change the solution/template to use double for these fields and then explicitly specify (and implement) how methods returning int (e.g., getTotalNumberOfStudents, getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) convert from double (round/truncate).
